name: Fifty additional bulk-query, caching, optimistic UI, preloading and advanced candidates
counting: Ten distinct new measured candidates from each of five agents. A retained improvement or evidenced rejection counts once. Prototype tuning, correctness repairs, tests, builds, qualification, documentation and release administration count zero.

command: perf: reduce wiki query and optimistic update overhead
normalCommitFirstAttempt.cause: The generic API-key secret detector matched ten synthetic benchmark labels under measurementKey. Renamed the documentation field to measurementLabel; numeric evidence and production source are unchanged. No allowlist, suppression, hook bypass or baseline edit.

reproduce: Follow the fixture commands and raw-artifact hashes in each of the five scope records. Use the same locked dependency/tool versions and fixture parameters in both arms.
Serialize local paired probes through /private/tmp/sarj-wiki-perf-round6-benchmark-guard.py; do not overlap benchmarks with builds or type checks.
Run the unchanged make check with the pinned toolchain and explicitly enabled owned loopback PostgreSQL QA, bulk and cache fixtures.
From repository root: node frontend/scripts/benchmark-bundle.mjs frontend/.next
limitations: CPU, SDK response sizes, SQL timings and resource counts are controlled local fixtures; they do not establish production load time or an absolute optimization maximum.
Array-bound recent-alias timing depends on PostgreSQL plan/statistics behavior. Custom-plan and small-key controls, regressions and exact API bounds are preserved in the bulk record.
Some accepted candidates reduce bounded allocations, native resources or task ownership without a measured latency gain. Small/large workload controls and noisy tails are reported separately.
Optimistic values remain pending until the server confirms them. Fresh authoritative reads, session retirement, failures and overlapping writes retain ownership-aware reconciliation and rollback.
Speculation retains reduced-motion paints, foreground query retries, network/device policy, session ownership, exact candidate ordering and the existing iframe cap.
Frontend inventories exclude shared framework assets and deferred chunks and are separate from live transfer/LCP measurements.

Normal commit/pre-push hooks, all hosted required checks, exact merged-tree release identity, authenticated production navigation and guarded source sync remain required after the initial integrated gate. Their final receipts are recorded separately to avoid self-referential commit identifiers.
